cards.name: Arrow 1
cards.summary: Illustrator Stroke-panel arrowhead. Large, wide solid black barbed head with deeply swept-back barbs and a concave back; the boldest of the classic pointed heads. Seen in a scripted render (the library symbol from Arrowheads.ai placed over both ends of a 6 pt line, start end turned 180 degrees), not a true Stroke-panel application.
avoid: thin hairline diagrams where a wide head overwhelms the line: use Arrow 2 or Arrow 10
scripted pipelines that need a native arrowhead: there is no DOM property, so route through an action, a graphic style or a placed symbol
cards.applies_to: stroked open path (line, open curve, connector); no effect without a stroke or on a closed path
cards.how_to_apply: Select a stroked open path > Window > Stroke (Ctrl+F10) > Show Options > Arrowheads: pick "Arrow 1" in the left (start) and/or right (end) dropdown; set Scale % and Align (tip beyond / at end of path). Not in the scripting DOM: from a script, play a recorded action or apply a graphic style that carries this arrowhead, or open Arrowheads.ai (invoke file) and place document.symbols.getByName("Arrow 1") at the path end, rotated to its tangent.

verified.note: Largest of the barbed heads (about 30 px tall): solid black, swept-back barbs, notched back.

review.changes: render note: 'start end mirrored' -> 'start end turned 180 degrees' (the start copy has top and bottom swapped)
